section.39: The Book on the Description of Hellfire

39.name_native: The Book on the Description of Hellfire

hadiths.text: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Prophet (s.a.w) said:"The Fire was kindled for one thousand years until it reddened, then it was kindled for one thousand years until it whitened, then it was kindled for one thousand years until it became blackened, so it is dark black
